tasks.task: I’m preparing a quick brand voice refresher for Northstar Social Lab that must be finished today. Using the @northstarsocial account in workspace “Northstar Social Lab” (xws_01J2Y7P8ZQ6R5Q4E4T3M7K1J9A), first summarize its recent timeline (exclude retweets), then analyze the profile (refresh it), and finally generate 3 tweet options in that voice announcing an “async batching” ingestion performance win (mention ~18% p95 improvement) with a soft call-to-action. Keep the generated tweets under 260 characters each. After you generate them, confirm that the new generation runs appear in the workspace run list.
